lag.evidence_source: The sample mean age was 11.61 years (SD = .96) [at Time 1]... the mean age of the 367 participants retained for longitudinal analysis was 16.77 years (SD = .94) [at Time 2]. Lag = 16.77 - 11.61 = 5.16 years.
